why.en: Listed small village under the Château de Verteuil on the Charente; a pretty halt, but there is little to fill an afternoon.

why.it: Piccolo borgo certificato sotto lo Château de Verteuil, sulla Charente; una bella sosta, ma poco per un pomeriggio.

why.en: Listed Breton small town by its lakes, with a calvary and Notre-Dame church, Hunaudaye castle 7 km away; quiet and quickly seen.

why.en: Listed Auvergne village with a château and timber-framed houses, Montpeyroux abbey 4 km away; small, an hour at most.

why.en: West Swedish port town with its church and Gustafsberg bathing resort 3 km out; a plain centre with little to hold a visitor.

why.en: Österlen village with Glimmingehus castle 6 km and beaches such as Haväng within 19 km; a base, with nothing of its own to see.

why.en: Listed village north of Rome, the Roman sites of Lucus Feroniae and Villa dei Volusii 8 km away; little to see in the village.
